target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`claude-fable-5` — a production Anthropic model — was missing from the CLI provider path (`extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts` + `cli-catalog.ts`), while the direct Anthropic provider path (`register.runtime.ts`) already has full support via `isAnthropicFable5Model()` / `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()`.

Four metadata layers were missing, plus the `fable`/`fable-5` aliases weren't routed through the context/model-ref canonicalization paths:

| Layer | File | Consequence |
|-------|------|-------------|
| allowlist | `cli-constants.ts` | `openclaw configure` cannot select fable-5 |
| aliases | `cli-constants.ts` | `fable` / `fable-5` aliases unresolvable |
| label | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to bare `${id} (Claude CLI)` |
| context window | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to 200K instead of 1M |
| context/model-ref canonicalization | `claude-model-refs.ts`, `prepare.ts` | Bare `fable` alias uses 200K fallback instead of 1M |
| **fixed context window resolver** | `context-resolution.ts` | `claude-cli` excluded from Fable 5/Mythos 5 provider checks |

This is the same root cause as #100572: a new model was registered in the direct API path but the CLI path's independently-maintained constants were not updated.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add fable-5 entries to the four CLI metadata layers **and** route the `fable` family alias through both canonicalization paths:

1. `claude-model-refs.ts`: add `fable: "claude-fable-5"` to `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL_BY_FAMILY` so `resolveClaudeCliAnthropicModelRefs("claude-cli/fable")` returns the correct 1M reference instead of falling through to `CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_ALIASES["fable"]` which returns bare `"fable"`
2. `prepare.ts`: add `fable`/`fable-5` aliases to `CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_MODEL_ALIASES` so context budgeting doesn't fall to the 200K default
3. `context-resolution.ts`: add `claude-cli` to the Fable 5 and Mythos 5 fixed context window provider checks so `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow("claude-cli", "claude-fable-5")` returns `ANTHROPIC_FABLE_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (1M) instead of falling through to the 200K default
4. `cli-migration.test.ts`: update 3 migration test expectations to include `sonnet-5`/`fable-5` entries produced by the updated allowlist

## User Impact

- `openclaw configure` can now select `claude-fable-5` for the Claude CLI provider
- Aliases `fable` / `fable-5` / `claude-fable-5` resolve with correct 1M context window (was 200K)

## Evidence

### Tests

- `pnpm test src/agents/context.test.ts` — 67 passed (includes `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` and `claude-cli/claude-mythos-5` context-window test cases)
- `pnpm test extensions/anthropic/` — 118 passed across 8 test files (cli-migration, index, provider-runtime.contract, stream-wrappers, claude-model-refs, lifecycle, pricing, snapshot)
- oxlint — clean (0 warnings)
- `pnpm format:check` — clean (7 files)
- CI: all passing (Critical Quality, Security High, dependency-guard, Socket Security, CodeQL)

### Real Behavior Proof — Module-level Runtime Verification

Built from the latest head (`96470ba`) with `pnpm build`, then verified each layer at the exported-module boundary:

#### 1. CLI Allowlist

```
$ node --import tsx -e "
import { CLAUDE_CLI_DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST_REFS } from './extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts';
console.log(CLAUDE_CLI_DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST_REFS.includes('claude-cli/claude-fable-5'));
"
PASS
```

Full allowlist: `claude-cli/claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-cli/claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-cli/claude-fable-5`, `claude-cli/claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-cli/claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-cli/claude-opus-4-6`

#### 2. CLI Aliases

```
fable -> fable
fable-5 -> claude-fable-5
claude-fable-5 -> claude-fable-5
```

#### 3. Catalog Entry

```json
{
  "id": "claude-fable-5",
  "name": "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)",
  "provider": "claude-cli",
  "reasoning": true,
  "input": ["text", "image"],
  "mediaInput": { "image": { "maxSidePx": 2576, "preferredSidePx": 2576, "tokenMode": "provider" } },
  "contextWindow": 1000000
}
```

#### 4. Fixed Context Window Resolution

```
anthropic/claude-fable-5:         1000000
anthropic-vertex/claude-fable-5:  1000000
claude-cli/claude-fable-5:        1000000  ← was undefined before fix
anthropic/claude-mythos-5:        1000000
anthropic-vertex/claude-mythos-5: 1000000
claude-cli/claude-mythos-5:       1000000  ← was undefined before fix
openai/claude-fable-5:            undefined (non-Anthropic — correct)
google/claude-fable-5:            undefined (non-Anthropic — correct)
```

#### 5. Model Ref Resolution

```
fable   -> { selectedRef: "anthropic/fable",   rewriteRef: "anthropic/claude-fable-5" }
fable-5 -> { selectedRef: "anthropic/fable-5", rewriteRef: "anthropic/claude-fable-5" }
```

#### 6. Build Verification

`pnpm build` — 402s, all phases green. Shared chunk `dist/cli-catalog-BwCh5-WO.js` includes fable-5 context window, label, and media-image resolution.

### Running CLI

`pnpm openclaw models list --all` shows `anthropic/claude-fable-5` in the full catalog with 1000k context, text+image input. The `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` catalog entry is generated at runtime by `buildClaudeCliCatalogEntries()` → `augmentModelCatalog` and is consumed by `augmentModelCatalogWithProviderPlugins` in the model-catalog pipeline.

### Limitations

- **Not tested with a real Claude CLI subscription.** This system does not have an active Claude subscription, so the actual `claude auth login` flow, live model selection via `openclaw configure`, and end-to-end CLI agent turn with `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` were not exercised. The fix is source-reproducible and all module-level contracts are verified.
- The overlapping PR #101368 (narrower context-window-only fix) should be closed or retargeted if this broader PR lands, to avoid duplicate context test changes.
